notes.title: 1.0.3 update
notes.content:
・Fixed some spelling mistakes in the English version.
・Fixed a bug that prevented Serene and Malice's event battle from progressing under certain conditions.
・Fixed a bug where the scene names on the list screen in the English version of the CG collection were displayed as the Japanese version.
・Fixed a bug that occurred when Ledah selected "Escape" during battle.
・Fixed a bug where some of Ledah's voice acting was not registered in the item library.
・Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: 1.0.1 update
notes.content:
・Fixed some spelling mistakes in the English version.
・Fixed the part where LOOK mode is written as QUEST mode in the English version.
・Fixed a crash issue on startup caused by the "Save Screen size" setting.
・Fixed an icon display bug that occurred under certain conditions.
